BiblicalUsage: Binnui = "built up"; 1) an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah; 2) a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah; 3) another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife; 4) still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
